source.name: Condition monitoring of hydraulic systems (ZeMA test rig)
source.citation: Helwig, N., Pignanelli, E. & Schütze, A. (2015). Condition monitoring of hydraulic systems. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
source.rig: Hydraulic test rig, ZeMA – Centre for Mechatronics and Automation, Saarland University
source.note: Real measurements, downsampled to 1 Hz per 60 s load cycle. Cycle time is not recorded by the rig and stays simulated.
